answer: A farm faking 447 aliases needs 447 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The seat is earned with emergency medical technician certification: a certification the board renews after assessed ambulance shifts. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The pearl record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the oasis entry is checkable by anyone, and the mesa window closes before a farm can catch up.
